title: Create Dataproc Cluster
description: Creates a new Dataproc cluster with a master and worker nodes.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to create a basic Dataproc cluster using the `create_cluster` method. A cluster is a collection of Compute Engine instances that run Hadoop, Spark, Hive, and other open-source data tools. The creation process is an asynchronous operation, and the sample waits for the operation to complete.
